sentence: This project builds methods and software to find the causes of disease by analyzing many kinds of omics data together.
This project tests a platform that uses video analysis to give automated feedback on surgical performance in cataract surgery.
This project offers islet isolation and tests of pancreatic islet function in rodent models to support diabetes research.
This project uses machine learning on clinical features and lung transcriptomics to predict which pneumonia patients will be cured.
This project tests whether a video telehealth treatment can reduce unhealthy drinking and chronic pain in people living with HIV.
This project develops a gene therapy to treat severe pain in older individuals.
This project studies how vaping electronic cigarettes during development changes the form and function of the developing brain.
This project studies how the gut microbiome affects human metabolic health, using human microbiomes and germ-free mice.
This project builds devices that deliver lithium ions for neural inhibition to treat neuropathic pain.
This project follows cognitive testing and mitochondrial energy production across the lifespan of marmosets to learn how mitochondria affect cognitive aging.
This project studies how sex chromosomes and an X-linked gene shape lung injury in a mouse model of bronchopulmonary dysplasia.
This project studies how transcription factors and enhancers control mast cell lineage commitment and allergic anaphylaxis.
This project provides technologies in functional genomics, molecular bioimaging and bioinformatics to help investigators study the metabolic basis of disease.
This project builds a catheter system that combines two optical methods to image plaque in coronary arteries.
This project studies how aging of stromal niche cells affects intestinal stem cells, using organoid co-culture systems and mouse models.
This project studies how sugar molecules called glycans on antibodies change in Alzheimer's Disease.
This project uses CRISPR genome editing on blood forming cells to try to treat sickle cell disease.
This project tries to find small molecules that target the sperm-specific calcium channel for contraception.
This project tries to make thyroid hormone secreting follicular cells from human induced pluripotent stem cells.
